about: W-bed arm (c) reference workflows for rungs R1 and R3 (PROOF-LEDGER B10; W-BED.md §2.3, §4 arm c), frozen by sha256. Hand-written on flow-v3 from the task view, the W-BED rung spec and the author fixtures; never from a bed's generator, oracle or controls. Never tuned again: a change to either file fails references.test.mjs.
protocol: W-BED.md §2.3: author fixtures = wbed dev seeds 373-378 (inputs + referenceSolve outputs, d3 and d4); one validation on dev seeds 301-312 (d3, d4); because judges were stubs ($0), the '< 10/12' revision trigger was met for both rungs and each got its one revision; frozen whatever the score.

r1.entry: a solve.mjs for experiments/jit/run-compiled.mjs with flowPath FLOW_V3 (createFlow budgetUsd 0.40)

judges.dob-order:<SYS>: numeric birth-date order (+ dated switch) of a system whose notes state it in prose; Haiku then Sonnet on a failed quote check
judges.dob-order-second:<SYS>: Sonnet second opinion, only when unanimous cross-system evidence (>= 2 name-matched rows) contradicts the reading
judges.marker:<SYS>:<value>: VOID/KEEP of a row marker or COUNTS/DOES_NOT_COUNT of an invoice status the fixed note templates do not define; Haiku
judges.marker-tiebreak:<SYS>:<value>: Sonnet, only when a confident code reader disagrees with Haiku or Haiku failed
judges.place-country: one batched call for places that decide a local phone number needed by an identity link (spec 3(b))
judges.date-order:<SYS>: numeric invoice-date order, only when the consistent readings disagree on an invoice's side of the close date (never asked on the 72 validation tasks)
judges.vendex-entry:<id> / invoice-line:<SYS>: span extraction of a free-text line the code parser cannot read (never asked on the 72 validation tasks)

features.mapSites: one-item maps only: the item failure policy that lets a judge fail without ending the run (softJudge)

validatedV1.stubValidation: dev 301-312 d3/d4 under stubs A and B: 46/48 ok, 2 deopts guard:names-read (seed 311 d3: VENDEX name 'Ryōta Ōta' has a capital outside Latin-1)
revision: VENDEX name pattern: any Unicode capital (\p{Lu}) instead of [A-ZÀ-ÖØ-Þ] (the 311 d3 deopt)
country aliases gain the ISO alpha-2 code of every country in the spec's phone table (a bare 'CA' went to the place judge on 308 d4)

the birth-date code reader reads only sentences about birth dates or numeric dates (a LEDGR sentence about restored change dates made it defer LEDGR's stated day.month.year to a judge on 301 d4, 303 d3, 311 d3)

r3.entry: a solve.mjs for experiments/jit/run-compiled.mjs with flowPath FLOW_V3 (createFlow budgetUsd 0.60; flow.wide budgetUsd 0.40, itemFloorUsd 0.002, concurrency 8, maxFanout 64)

wide.name: statements
wide.worker: code: parse, match, rule-decide DUPLICATE/TIMING, judge the rest, adjusted balance
wide.reduce: code: per supplier per reason sum, convert once, six reasons, totals
wide.verify: code: Z4 coverage, Z3 fan-in conservation

judges.reason:<PRICE|FX|MISSING_CREDIT>: per remaining difference a note could explain: the candidate or UNEXPLAINED with the quoted sentence; code checks the quote occurs in this supplier's notes and names neither another document nor (credits) another amount; Haiku then Sonnet; a supplier with no notes gets UNEXPLAINED without a call
judges.date-order:<SYS>: only when both day orders fit a statement's dates (never asked on the 72 validation tasks)

invariants: statement-running-balance (every amount and sign against the printed running balance and the closing line)
Z1-item-conservation (statement - ledger = sum of discrepancies, per supplier)

bedFinding.finding: The R3 oracle's by_reason usd_cents and totals are not reproducible from the task: on all 12 author fixtures the labelled values differ from the spec's rule ('add each supplier's amounts per reason, convert that sum once at the quote below, half away from zero') by +1 to +50 cents per reason; no reading of the printed quotes (per supplier, per discrepancy, per currency, rounding once) reproduces them, consistent with truth computed at rates more precise than the 4-decimal quotes the spec prints. With the correct reason on every discrepancy, the reference's statements equal the bed reference's in 36/36 tasks and its totals in 0/36, so the oracle fails it 36/36; a black-box probe (the reference's answer with the bed reference's totals swapped in) passes on fixtures 373 d3, 373 d4, 374 d3 and 375 d3.
